title: Lanes commit their handoff to the record branch and tag themselves archive-ready; the starter archives
why: The drain handoffs were written only in their containers and were lost with them at the Nov 11 respawn, the old triage handoff among them.
source: coordinator ask 22:49 CST Nov 11, from the retrospective order 22:44 CST
note: Done when: the archive or the rotation steps refuse or warn while a session handoff exists only in its container; the handoff goes to handoffs/ on the record branch first. Related: step handoff-checkpoint-before-cloud-compact; operating-model rotation step 3. Folds step lane-tags-archive-ready (owner rulings in the retrospective's chat 09:42 and 09:47 CST Nov 12, archivals option a): whoever starts a session answers for archiving it; the batch runner archives PR lanes after each merge, the coordinator archives every other finished session it started at each wake. Before it tags itself archive-ready, a lane runs a four-point self-check (work landed or handed off, no unpushed branch, handoff written, no owner question waiting) and commits its handoff to roadmap/outbox/<slug>-handoff.md; the tag names the slug, so the path is derived. Homes: decision session-tiers, Archiving scope (rewrite in place, keeps Nov 6 pick a and G3); skills/project-ops/templates/brief.md. First test whether a lane may add its own tag.
